entry.title: Issue 2: Prompt optimizers under scrutiny, Perseverance's Mars driving record and the Jio Platforms IPO lead the day, while Iran says Hormuz mines stalled tankers and Anirudh's Jailer 2 theme arrives for the movies and music slate.
entry.summary: Do prompt optimizers break requirements they are not scored on? A preregistered study; Reflective prompt optimizers: GEPA and SkillOpt tested on locally served reasoning models; Perseverance sets a new off-world driving record on Mars; Iran says its naval mines halted three tankers in the Strait of Hormuz; Jio Platforms IPO is subscribed about 3 times on day one, led by institutional buyers

entry.title: Issue 1: LLM judges that flip their own verdicts, OpenCode 2.1 and Salesforce's $5.7 billion Braze deal lead the day, while Euclid finds a comet, Hormuz tensions climb, and Diwali weekend events open in the South Bay.
entry.summary: LLM judges flip verdicts on reruns and answer-order swaps; one fully repeatable judge was right only 51% of the time; OpenCode 2.1.0 changes SDK, event and plugin contracts and adds Windows persistent terminals; Salesforce agrees to buy customer-engagement platform Braze for about $5.66 billion in cash; Euclid discovers its first new comet, C/2026 S1; US and Iran both claim control of the Strait of Hormuz as ship attacks climb
